speaker: CAMERA
text: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.

speaker: CAMERA
text: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: You should turn around, Juliana.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Why?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Gerald is waiting for me.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: Not anymore.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: What do you mean?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: Look for yourself.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Gerald?

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Why are you holding her hand?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: Because he is marrying me.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: No...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You let me come here...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: I changed my mind.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You swore you loved me!

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: People change their minds, sister.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: And you knew?

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: Of course I knew.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: How long?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Father...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Tell them this is a mistake.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Father... please look at me.

speaker: ACTION
text: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: Enough!

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Embarrassed you?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: And I am what?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: I am the daughter they choose.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

speaker: MATRIARCH
text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: So that is what I was worth to you?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: You have nothing to offer me anymore.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Clarissa's radiant, conceited smile basking in Gerald's words.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: ...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Tight insert on Juliana's white-knuckled hand clutching the gown fabric.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Push-in close-up on Juliana's tearful face. Her trembling mouth straightens, her tear-filled blue eyes hardening from sheer devastation into cold, resolute defiance.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.

speaker: SOUND FX
text: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Cut to black.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: You are far too plain...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: ...far too silent...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Gerald... Look at me.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You gave me your word before both our families.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: Promises change when a better choice appears.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: A better choice? Is that what she is?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Father...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.

speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.

speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
text: Do not disgrace us further.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You won't even look at me.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: That plain, old-fashioned gown.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: And that quiet little face.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: Gerald needs a real lady...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.

speaker: CAMERA
text: High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.

speaker: ACTION
text: The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Dignity?

speaker: CAMERA
text: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.

speaker: CAMERA
text: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

speaker: CAMERA
text: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.

speaker: LADY JULIANA
text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

speaker: ACTION
text: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.
